decisions.reason: Having survived the initial trial period and fitting closely with the firm's core industrial-door business, it likely has enough demonstrated value that the cost of keeping it is lower than the value of abandoning it now.
As a differentiated insulated variant in a core product family, it likely benefits from shared production and sales resources, so management would keep the option open unless demand clearly weakens.
Its separate product-page presence suggests a stronger commercial commitment and clearer market position, making continuation more likely than withdrawal after several years on the market.
